For a 50-person Indian company, three credible current options are:

Service	Price	Reliability / support	Key limitation
MakeMyTrip myBiz	No published platform fee; corporate fares	24×7 support, GST invoices, policy controls, expense management 
MakeMyTrip Biz
+1
	More self-serve than fully managed; exact corporate discounts vary
EaseMyTrip EMTDesk	Custom quote	4,000+ businesses; 24×7 support, centralised booking & expense controls 
EaseMyTrip
	Pricing/service SLA isn't publicly disclosed
FCM Travel India	Custom TMC quote	Full managed programme, corporate rates, global inventory; hotel programme claims savings up to 38% 
FCM Travel
+1
	More enterprise-oriented; likely higher service cost and onboarding effort

Purchase terms to verify: implementation/setup fee, per-booking/service fee, minimum annual spend, cancellation/change handling fees, credit terms, dedicated account manager, 24×7 escalation SLA, GST invoicing, and whether international support is included.

For a 50-person company, myBiz and EMTDesk are the easier low-friction quotes to obtain; FCM is the more traditional managed-TMC model.
